notes: Primary research article (Int J Hydrogen Energy 39 (2014) 8311-8320); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF; the paper makes no statement that its H2 uptake values were published before. Table 3 (main, p. 7) lists BET area with H2 uptake at stated T and P for GO (304 m2/g; 0.17 wt.% at 300 K/50 bar), TR-GO (375; 0.32 wt.% at 300 K/50 bar, 2.07 wt.% at 77 K/50 bar), CR-GO (9; 0.1 and 0.54 wt.%) and Fe-GS (190; 0.27 and 2.16 wt.%). Measurement is volumetric (Sieverts, PCT isotherms 0.1-50 bar, Figs. 5-7). Table 1 values are quoted from other work and were not used for any criterion. The authors also report He isotherms on TR-GO and interpret near-equal H2 and He volumes as 'no measurable excess adsorption'; this bears on uptake basis at extraction, not on eligibility.
